question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An imperfection; a blemish, a crack
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flaw**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Flaw **means an imperfection or a blemish. (एक अपूर्णता या दोष)
 
• It is a noun that can be used to describe any kind of fault or defect.
 
• It can also be used as a verb to mean to mar or spoil the perfection or excellence of something.
 
 
• **Example**: *The diamond had a flaw in it, which reduced its value.*
